title: Characterize residual floor attainment for different block bases
body:
## Summary

Close PR3579's different-basis equality handoff for fixed VVV residual queries, with arbitrary crossing cells and different full Gram-I bases in orthogonal binary blocks.

```text
VVV floor = n_1+3n_2+3n_3
attainment iff a pinned cell graph has an independent negative-cell set
               satisfying one weighted count equation per triple block
MMM minimum = 2n_1+3n_2+3n_3, always attained
```

The self-contained proof covers every coefficient field of characteristic different from two and arbitrary ambient readers, and gives explicit attaining readers. A matched five-cell example changes only one basis: the coordinate case attains 15, while the changed basis cannot attain that floor and its exact finite minimum is 17. This separates basis compatibility from dimension counts.

Only `research/p112-mixed-basis-attainment` is added. Proof, fixtures/results, two scientific calculations, optimized CLI controls and replay metadata are self-contained. Exact PR3569/3579 proof bytes are retained under COMPARISONS solely as handoff context, with origin commit/path/blob/SHA256. Every used mathematical ingredient is reproved locally; scientific replay needs no foreign Git objects or network. Credit retains Nick Petalas/PR3579/3569/3560/3549/3538, Philippe Van Velzen, Arham Tahir, Tekalign/PR3370 and the P112/E8/native/compiler lineage.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3579's exact-attainment criterion requires the same coordinate basis in shared blocks.
  **After:** The graph/count theorem permits different full Gram-I bases and proves the unpinned-component reduction. MMM attainment extends to the same geometry.
- Both calculations agree on all 28,269 VVV and 2,200 MMM assignments across 35 fixtures, complete four-charge streams, hashes, histograms, minima and equality witnesses. The separate raw rectangular-Gram calculation checks 17,032 doubled scalar-operator entries over integers and F3/F5/F7 with two external coordinates.
- Seven authenticated faults reject through both optimized actual CLIs, with 14 restored positives and two initial positives. Shared code is confined to byte/geometry parsing; scientific calculations are separate.
- CPython3.12 registered replay, metadata/pins, exact committed-byte/source-history checks and all three optimized commands in an owned regular inode-disjoint Git-free committed export pass at the publication commit. Source/export hashes stay unchanged; applicable Ruff and format checks pass.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-mixed-basis-attainment
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p112-mixed-basis-attainment --check-source-history
```

[Canonical investigation and original claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19013610). This is an author-checked scoped support-tariff theorem. Independent human/formal acceptance, hosted CI, a general efficient feasibility algorithm, nonreducing/partial geometry, arbitrary queries, physical execution, complete supplier/consumer invoices and outer transfer are unclaimed. No cheaper physical decoder, kappa improvement or selected-frontier change is claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** package

The isolated package preserves shared code, frozen predecessors, canonical sources and the selected frontier.
